about.description:
I'm a freelance full-stack developer and product builder who designs and engineers modern web apps, desktop tools, and developer experiences.

I work at the intersection of clean architecture, thoughtful UX, and practical performance.

I care deeply about tooling, automation, and the small details that turn good software into great products.

I enjoy building focused products with strong identity, fast feedback loops, and long-term maintainability in mind.
